about_the_game:
Part of the Important People of History series:

1. George Washington

2. Thomas Jefferson

3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Important People of History - Abraham Lincoln

In this biographical visual novel in the Important People of History series, get a first-hand look at Civil War sites and places where Abraham Lincoln himself walked - see how they look today

  • The log cabin at Lincoln's birthplace in Hodgenville, Kentucky (yes, Lincoln was born in Kentucky)

  • His home and final resting place in Springfield, Illinois

  • Fort Sumter, where the first shots of the US Civil War were fired

  • Gettysburg Battlefield, where Lincoln made the Gettysburg Address

  • The White House of the Confederacy in Richmond, Virginia

  • The parlor in Appomattox, Virginia where Ulysses S Grant accepted Robert E Lee's surrender to end the Civil War

  • Ford's Theatre, where Lincoln was assassinated

  • And many more

A House Divided Against Itself Cannot Stand

Abraham Lincoln walks you through the key events of his life and era, including the US Civil War and the fight to end slavery once and for all - on the battlefield, through the Emancipation Proclamation, and through the Thirteenth Amendment

Four Score and Seven Years Ago

Learn about Lincoln's great speeches, such as the Gettysburg Address and the House Divided speech

Any Nation So Conceived and So Dedicated Can Long Endure

Visit Civil War battlefields like Gettysburg, Richmond, Fort Sumter, Antietam, Petersburg, and even the site of final victory at Appomattox, Virginia

With Charity for All and Malice Toward None

See how Lincoln's legacy has reverberated through the ages and inspired humanity to be kinder to each other

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Pentium CPU G3220 @ 3.00 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: This game runs just fine on a desktop that was bottom of the line in 2015, so it probably runs fine on whatever machine you have

short_description: Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln! Proudly made in the Washington DC area
